title: When Brian Flores defenses face Kyle Shanahan offenses, Flores is 5-0

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: When Brian Flores defenses face Kyle Shanahan offenses, Flores is 5-0
sources.description: Teams with Flores as a head coach or defensive assistant have played against teams with Shanahan as a head coach or offensive assistant five times, and Flores is 5-0.
